decisions.target: customers who live paycheck to paycheck

actions.action: Savings rate boost for 4 weeks, balances up to $50,000
Early pay up to 2 days early, permanently

decisions.message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, about 12:00 Central, we move to a new banking system: your balance stays visible, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards pause. It may run some hours longer; we will post updates in the app. For the next 4 weeks, Cobalt savings earn an extra 0.25 points on balances up to $50,000. Paychecks paid into Cobalt can now show up to 2 days early, so Friday Dec 11 pay may arrive by Wed Dec 9. We have added 50 support staff for the coming weeks.
